name: elian-workflow
description: The development lifecycle as one plugin: which stage comes next and which skill runs there. Nineteen skills from idea through spec, issue kickoff, architecture, TDD implementation, engineering and persona review, verification, PR drafting, and the recorded issue history — plus the 30 domain and reviewer agents those stages dispatch. Overlaps elian-store by 17 skills; install one, not both. Only the two issue-cycle skills need configuration: they record work history to a Notion workspace described by a local config file the skill helps you create on first run.
